dynamic_subgoals.goal: Fail-fast validate the locked upstream port manifest and four-trial release manifest against the real HPC2 ALFWorld dataset bytes before any canary result is observed.
Capture sanitized HPC2 candidate, Python/import, ALFWorld/ai2thor/Unity, dataset/config, provider/model, display/GPU, and dependency identities with resolved-origin guards.
Run one fresh locked valid_unseen AlfredThorEnv visual_eval canary proving start/reset/scan/restore and explicit frame capture with complete reset fingerprint and raw evidence references.
Prove a real non-mock provider produced at least one recorded attempt and that the formal ALFWorld scorer is available, without requiring task success or treating M0 as the final 4/4 gate.

Emit and independently validate one sanitized machine-readable runtime qualification report whose hashes bind the immutable candidate, environment identity, release manifest, and fresh canary artifacts.

allowed_deltas: plan/V1.9/execution/m0/state.json phase state and sanitized evidence hashes
scripts/v19_release/** M0 qualification runner/verifier and shared release tooling
tests/homemaster/** focused M0 qualification and negative contract tests
no src/homemaster or apps/case02_openenv/src production changes unless a reproduced infrastructure blocker requires returning to CONTEXT_LOADED
test_commands: uv run pytest -q -m 'not live_api and not live_alfworld and not live_mcp and not live_coworker'
uv run ruff check src tests scripts/v19_release

evidence.details: Re-read M0 and shared phase/release sections in the comparison spec and implementation plan, CLAUDE.md ALFWorld rules, CL-01 port manifest, current ALFWorld environment/reset/runner/runtime/scorer owners and their tests.

Found ALFWorld source at aaba687, legacy Python 3.9 environment with alfworld 0.5.0 and ai2thor 2.1.0, 3.1 GB json_2.1.1 dataset with 255 valid_unseen trials, and no current DISPLAY/GPU/Conda identity; root uv Python 3.11 has no alfworld or ai2thor import.

Added the fresh one-trial M0 qualification runner, stdlib-only independent verifier, raw reset/frame/provider/scorer artifact binding, and strict HPC2/hkust4 identity branches. Per user direction, Xorg/THOR/provider live checks are deferred for one concentrated hkust4 batch using conda run -n hm_alfworld; no phase review or gate claim is made before that batch passes.
